skill.description: Use when planning or restructuring paid ad accounts. It chooses campaign types, groups ad or asset groups by intent, and plans targeting, match types, negatives, and exclusions. It checks paid versus organic overlap and scores the ROAS Audience dimension. Use ad-account-auditor for the final RQS.

content.value_statement: Paid accounts often waste budget through overlapping campaigns and weak negatives. This skill builds a clear structure, match-type plan, and cannibalization read before launch.
actual_capabilities: Selects Search, Performance Max, broad match, or mixed campaign structures based on goals and data readiness.
Maps ad groups or asset groups around one clear intent theme per group.
Plans targeting, match types, audience signals, and placement exclusions for paid campaigns.
Builds negative keyword and exclusion hygiene from search-term and campaign exports.
Checks paid query themes against organic traffic data to flag possible cannibalization.
Scores the ROAS Audience dimension and prepares a handoff for ad-account-auditor.
limitations: Does not compute the final RQS score or enforce all ROAS veto items.
Does not allocate budgets or decide spend splits across campaigns.
Needs user-provided exports or pasted campaign details for evidence-based recommendations.
Does not replace platform approval, legal review, or brand-safety policy review.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Search Launch
use_cases.description: Create campaign types, ad groups, match types, and negatives before a new Google Ads launch.

use_cases.title: Restructure a Messy Account
use_cases.description: Turn overlapping campaigns and mixed intent groups into a cleaner account structure with clearer exclusions.

use_cases.title: Check Paid and Organic Overlap
use_cases.description: Compare paid query themes with organic landing page traffic before scaling spend.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Campaign Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with goal and platform only.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a paid ad account structure for [business goal] on [platform]. Recommend campaign types, ad groups, targeting, match types, and first negative keyword themes.

prompt_templates.title: Search Terms Restructure
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request using exported search-term data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this campaign export and search-terms report to restructure my account. Identify overlapping themes, propose ad groups, assign match types, and build cross-campaign negatives.

prompt_templates.title: PMax Versus Search Decision
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate whether this goal should use Search, Performance Max, broad match, or a mixed structure. Include the control versus reach tradeoff and readiness gaps for feed, creative, and conversion data.

prompt_templates.title: Cannibalization Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced paid and organic overlap review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit paid versus organic cannibalization using this GA4 traffic-acquisition export and campaign report. Flag query themes where paid spend may add low incremental value and recommend structure changes.

output_examples.input: A SaaS team wants to launch Google Ads for demo requests with brand, competitor, and problem-aware keywords.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a campaign map separating brand, competitor, and nonbrand intent. It recommends exact and phrase match by theme, cross-campaign negatives, and a handoff note for full ROAS auditing.

output_examples.input: An ecommerce account has broad match, Performance Max, and Search campaigns bidding on similar product terms.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies internal overlap, recommends clearer Search and Performance Max roles, adds negative themes, and marks missing placement data as needed input for brand-safety scoring.

output_examples.input: A growth lead provides GA4 acquisition data and paid search query themes for a mature content site.
output_examples.output: The skill flags themes where organic pages already capture high-intent traffic, suggests lower paid priority, and documents where paid coverage still supports incremental reach.

best_practices: Provide campaign exports, search-term reports, audience reports, and GA4 traffic-acquisition data when available.
State the business goal and conversion priority before asking for campaign-type recommendations.
Use the output as a structure handoff, then run ad-account-auditor for the final ROAS gate.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to approve spend levels or final budget allocation.
Do not treat missing placement or search-term exports as evidence that the account is clean.
Do not mix unrelated keyword intents into one ad group because volume looks low.

faq.question: Does this skill build ads or write creative?
faq.answer: No. It designs account and campaign structure. Use ad-creative-builder for ads, copy, and creative assets.

faq.question: Can it choose between Search and Performance Max?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares goal, intent maturity, control needs, feed readiness, and creative readiness before recommending a campaign type.

faq.question: Does it need direct Google Ads API access?
faq.answer: No. It can work from pasted details or manual exports. MCP or platform tools are optional convenience paths.

faq.question: Will it calculate the final ROAS quality score?
faq.answer: No. It scores the Audience dimension and passes findings to ad-account-auditor for the full RQS review.

faq.question: Can it find paid and organic cannibalization?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares paid query themes with GA4 organic traffic data and flags likely low-incrementality overlap.

faq.question: What data should I provide first?
faq.answer: Start with the goal, platform, current campaign export, search-term report, audience or placement report, and GA4 traffic-acquisition export.
